# Awesome Animation — agent index (llms.txt)

> GENERATED from README.md by scripts/awesome_kg.py — edit the README, not this file.
> One line per tool: tier name — use-case · license/pricing [link].
> Full typed graph: knowledge/graph.json

## 🌊 Web / JS animation — timeline, tween & UI motion
- 🥇 GSAP — The pro timeline engine — scroll, SVG, precise sequencing. Now 100% free incl. all plugins (2025). Reach for orchestrated, exact motion. · Free (GSAP Standard License) [https://github.com/greensock/GSAP]
- 🥇 Motion — Formerly Framer Motion — spring/layout/gesture animation for React & JS. The default for app UIs. · MIT (core; Motion+ paid) · agentic: agents-dir+agents-md+claude-md+cursor-rules [https://github.com/motiondivision/motion]
- 🥇 Anime.js — Lightweight, expressive timeline for DOM/SVG/JS objects (v4, 2025). · MIT [https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime]
- 🥇 Lenis — Smooth-scroll foundation that scroll-driven motion is built on. · MIT [https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis]
- 🥈 React Spring — Spring-physics animation for React. · MIT [https://github.com/pmndrs/react-spring]
- 🥈 AutoAnimate — One line → automatic add/remove/move transitions. Zero-config delight. · MIT [https://github.com/formkit/auto-animate]
- 🥈 Tween.js — Minimal tweening primitive, often paired with Three.js. · MIT [https://github.com/tweenjs/tween.js]
- 🥉 Motion One — Tiny (~2kb) WAAPI-based animator. · MIT [https://github.com/motiondivision/motionone]
- 🥉 Theatre.js — Visual sequence editor for JS & 3D. · Apache-2.0 / AGPL studio [https://github.com/theatre-js/theatre]
- 🥉 Mo.js — Motion-graphics toolkit for the web. · MIT [https://github.com/mojs/mojs]
- 🥉 fading Popmotion — Being absorbed into Motion — prefer Motion. · MIT [https://github.com/Popmotion/popmotion]
- 🥉 dead Velocity.js — Historic jQuery-era animator, unmaintained since 2020. · MIT [https://github.com/julianshapiro/velocity]

## 🎨 CSS / utility & component motion
- 🥇 Sonner — Emil Kowalski's toast — the craft reference (13M+ weekly npm). · MIT [https://github.com/emilkowalski/sonner]
- 🥇 Vaul — Emil Kowalski's drawer — physics-y, accessible. · MIT [https://github.com/emilkowalski/vaul]
- 🥇 Magic UI — Animated React/Tailwind components, shadcn-style registry. · MIT (+ Pro) · agentic: agents-md+skills-dir [https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui]
- 🥇 Aceternity UI — Copy-paste flashy animated sections. · MIT free + Pro [https://ui.aceternity.com]
- 🥈 rising tw-animate-css — Tailwind v4 animation utilities — the current shadcn default. · MIT [https://github.com/Wombosvideo/tw-animate-css]
- 🥈 Animate.css — Drop-in CSS keyframe classes. Note the non-standard license. · Hippocratic 2.1 (ethical, not OSI) [https://github.com/animate-css/animate.css]
- 📚 resource animations.dev — Emil Kowalski's animation course — the craft curriculum. · Commercial course [https://animations.dev]
- 🥉 tailwindcss-animate — v3-era; superseded by tw-animate-css. · MIT [https://github.com/jamiebuilds/tailwindcss-animate]
- 🥉 fading AOS — Animate-on-scroll, low maintenance. · MIT [https://github.com/michalsnik/aos]

## 🪁 Lottie / vector runtimes — designer-authored motion
- 🥇 Lottie (lottie-web) — Play After-Effects vector animations as JSON on the web. The foundation (aging). · MIT [https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web]
- 🥇 Rive — Interactive, state-machine vector animation — small, real-time, input-driven. · MIT runtimes (editor SaaS) [https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime]
- 🥇 dotLottie — The modern Lottie player/format (compressed, themable). · MIT · agentic: skill-md [https://github.com/LottieFiles/dotlottie-web]
- 🥇 lottie-react-native — Lottie for React Native. · Apache-2.0 [https://github.com/lottie-react-native/lottie-react-native]
- 🥇 platform LottieFiles — The vector-animation ecosystem — marketplace, tools, players, MCP. · Proprietary SaaS (free tier) [https://lottiefiles.com]
- 🥈 SVGator — No-code SVG animation editor. · Proprietary SaaS (free tier) [https://svgator.com]

## 3D / WebGL / shaders — immersive & generative motion
- 🥇 Three.js — The WebGL 3D standard. · MIT · agentic: llms-txt [https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js]
- 🥇 PixiJS — Fast 2D WebGL renderer for effects & particles. · MIT · agentic: skills-dir [https://github.com/pixijs/pixijs]
- 🥇 React Three Fiber — Three.js as declarative React components. · MIT [https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber]
- 🥇 Babylon.js — Full-featured 3D engine (games, XR). · Apache-2.0 [https://github.com/BabylonJS/Babylon.js]
- 🥈 drei — R3F helpers — the batteries for react-three-fiber. · MIT [https://github.com/pmndrs/drei]
- 🥈 PlayCanvas — 3D engine with a cloud editor. · MIT (editor freemium) [https://github.com/playcanvas/engine]
- 🥈 p5.js — Creative-coding for generative/ambient motion. · LGPL-2.1 [https://github.com/processing/p5.js]
- 🥇 no-code Spline — No-code 3D design & animation, exportable to web. · Proprietary SaaS (free tier) [https://spline.design]
- 🥉 OGL — Minimal WebGL when Three.js is too heavy. · Unlicense [https://github.com/oframe/ogl]
- 📚 resource Shadertoy — The fragment-shader learning & sharing hub (not a dependency). · Platform (per-shader) [https://www.shadertoy.com]
- 🥉 fading Zdog — Pseudo-3D round vector illustrations (dormant). · MIT [https://github.com/metafizzy/zdog]

## 🎞 Video-as-code — a composition rendered to frames
- 🥇 HeyGen Hyperframes — Agent-native: author HTML/CSS/GSAP, render MP4 locally (headless-Chrome+FFmpeg), deterministic. The center of "video as code for agents." · Apache-2.0 (no render fees) · agentic: agents-dir+agents-md+claude-md+claude-plugin+claude-skills+codex-plugin+cursor-plugin+skills-dir+skills-manifest [https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes]
- 🥇 Remotion — Make videos in React — data-driven, programmatic MP4. Note the tiered commercial license. · Source-available (free ≤3 ppl; paid 4+) · agentic: agents-dir+agents-md+claude-md+claude-skills [https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion]
- 🥈 Motion Canvas — Code-driven vector animation with a visual editor — great for explainers. · MIT core (org exploring GPL) [https://github.com/motion-canvas/motion-canvas]
- 🥈 Revideo — Programmatic video built on Motion Canvas, API-first. · MIT [https://github.com/redotvideo/revideo]
- 🥉 Editly — Declarative FFmpeg video editing from a spec. · MIT [https://github.com/mifi/editly]

## AI / agent-authored animation — a prompt or reference → a composition
- 🥇 HeyGen Hyperframes — Agent-native: author HTML/CSS/GSAP, render MP4 locally (headless-Chrome+FFmpeg), deterministic. The center of "video as code for agents." · Apache-2.0 (no render fees) · agentic: agents-dir+agents-md+claude-md+claude-plugin+claude-skills+codex-plugin+cursor-plugin+skills-dir+skills-manifest [https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes]
- 🥇 Manim (Community) — The most LLM-authorable animator — Python `Scene` classes, huge training footprint. Ideal for agent-generated explainers. · MIT [https://github.com/ManimCommunity/manim]
- 🥇 Remotion Agent Skills — Official Agent Skills (Jan 2026) for Claude Code/Cursor — agents author React video. · Source-available · agentic: agents-dir+agents-md+claude-md+claude-skills [https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion]
- 🥈 product Claude Design / Artifacts — The mainstream path for an LLM to author self-contained animated HTML/CSS/JS. · Proprietary product [https://claude.ai]
- 🌱 emerging Lottie Creator MCP — LottieFiles' MCP — the most production-credible agent path to vector animation. · Proprietary [https://lottiefiles.com]
- 🌱 emerging css-animation-skill — A Claude Code skill that teaches an agent CSS-animation craft. · MIT [https://github.com/neonwatty/css-animation-skill]
- 🔗 adjacent claude-video `/watch` — Lets an agent watch a reference video (yt-dlp + FFmpeg + Whisper). Comprehension, not authoring — the "study a reference" half of the loop. · MIT [https://github.com/bradautomates/claude-video]

## 🎥 Commercial generative video (proprietary SaaS)
- 🥇 Runway — Production text/image→video suite (Gen-4). · Free / $15 / $35 / $95 · API ~$0.05–0.40/s [https://runwayml.com]
- 🥇 OpenAI Sora 2 — Frontier-quality generative video. · ChatGPT Plus $20 / Pro $200 [https://openai.com/sora]
- 🥇 Google Veo 3.1 — 4K generation with lip-sync. · API $0.15–0.75/s [https://deepmind.google/models/veo]
- 🥇 Kling 3.0 — Best price/quality generative video. · from ~$6/mo [https://klingai.com]
- 🥇 HeyGen — AI-avatar spokesperson video. · Free / $29 / $99 / $149 [https://heygen.com]
- 🥇 Synthesia — Enterprise avatar video. · Free / $29 / $89 / Ent [https://synthesia.io]
- 🥈 Pika — Fast, playful generative video. · from ~$8/mo [https://pika.art]
- 🥈 Luma Dream Machine — Text/image→video. · Free / ~$30 / ~$90 [https://lumalabs.ai]
- 🥈 Jitter — Motion-design tool (not AI-gen) — quick branded animation. · Free / ~$16/mo [https://jitter.video]
- 🥇 Adobe After Effects — The professional motion-graphics incumbent. · $22.99/mo [https://www.adobe.com/products/aftereffects.html]
